verdict.rationale: Aircall ships AI features such as assistants, agents, transcription and summaries, so an AI-training opt-out is a fair question for this product. However, nothing in the evidence documents a setting, policy or contractual control that keeps customer data out of model training. Pausing call recording and importing recordings into your own infrastructure are adjacent controls and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
